pages.title: Acoustic Singularity
pages.text: By binding $(2)Trinitite$(0) atomic glass with $(3)Echo Shards$(0) and a Blast Furnace, you construct the $(2)Echoing Blast Chamber$(0).$(br2)This chamber harnesses acoustic resonance so intense that soundwaves act as physical hydraulic vices, forcing opposing elemental matter into harmonic collapse.

pages.title: Harmonic Overdrive
pages.text: Insert a $(6)Blaze Rod$(0) (superheated Nether fire) and a $(b)Breeze Rod$(0) (turbulent Trial wind) into the chamber.$(br2)Over 10 seconds of deafening acoustic pressure, the rods fuse in a contained sonic detonation into an $(5)Overdrive Rod$(0)—a double-helix core of pure kinetic and thermal power.

pages.title: Catalytic Reagent
pages.text: Pulverizing an Overdrive Rod yields $(5)Overdrive Powder$(0).$(br2)This volatile particulate reagent is indispensable across the Manhattan Project: it binds exotic $(d)Magicite Summons$(0) in the Transmutation Cube and activates the $(2)Tabbyrium Blossom Sapling$(0).
